test_evaluator_suffix: test that the Evaluator correctly stores and uses file suffixes for different programming languages
test_process_parallel_controller_suffix: test that ProcessParallelController correctly passes file suffix to worker processes
test_file_extension_preservation: test that file extensions are preserved across iterations using Path suffix extraction
test_worker_suffix_access: test that worker processes can access file suffix from config using getattr with default fallback
test_evaluator_temp_file_creation: test that Evaluator creates temporary files with the correct file suffix for each language
